column1: # Piano Prof — shared partition table for the ESP32-S3-MINI-1-N4R2 (4 MB flash).
# Used by BOTH firmware/factory and firmware/controller. The two projects MUST
# agree on this layout: the bootloader reads one table from flash
# means whichever image was flashed last silently relocates the other's slots.
#   factory  the minimal BLE + OTA recovery image (firmware/factory). Flashed
#            once over USB. Nothing ever overwrites it
#            With empty/invalid otadata the bootloader boots factory
#            virgin board comes up advertising BLE.
#   ota_1    / Updates alternate between the two
#            never clobber the copy that is currently running.
# All three app slots are 0x140000 (1.25 MB) — the same size Arduino's stock
# default.csv gives an app — so anything that fits the normal build fits here.
# Offsets: app partitions must be aligned to 0x10000.
